channel.title: Financial Conduct Authority - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Financial Conduct Authority (fca.org.uk)

item.title: FCA confirms new incident and third party rules to bolster resilience
item.description: We’ve confirmed new rules to make existing incident and third party reporting clearer, more consistent, and easier for firms to follow.

item.title: Creating a redress system that works better for consumers and firms
item.description: We’ve reached a significant milestone in our joint work with the Financial Ombudsman Service and the Government to modernise the redress system so that consumers get fair outcomes quicker and firms have greater clarity about how issues will be handled. We’re delivering change at speed by acting now within our current powers, with a focus on improving how the system works in practice. item.title: FCA bans Kasim Garipoglu from working in UK financial services
item.description: Kasim Garipoglu has been banned from working in UK financial services. The FCA found he is not fit and proper because of his lack of honesty and integrity.

item.title: Concept Capital Group update: administrators appointed
item.description: On 9 March 2026, the High Court placed Concept Capital Group (CCG) into administration. BTG are the administrators of the company.

item.title: Second charge mortgage firms told to raise standards for consumers
item.description: Lenders and brokers in the second charge mortgage market need to consider how they advise customers, assess affordability and charge fees.

item.title: FCA confirms motor finance redress scheme
item.description: We are going ahead with a scheme to compensate motor finance customers who were treated unfairly.

item.title: Millions of car finance customers to get payouts this year as FCA goes ahead with compensation scheme
item.description: Millions of motor finance customers will receive compensation this year under an FCA scheme for those treated unfairly by firms who broke the law by failing to disclose important information.

item.title: Shojin Financial Services Limited enters administration
item.description: Shojin Financial Services Limited (Shojin) is a crowdfunding platform authorised and regulated by the FCA.

item.title: Regulators launch joint taskforce to crack down on poor practice in motor finance claims
item.description: A new taskforce will tackle poor handling of motor finance claims by some claims management companies (CMCs) and law firms, after the FCA, Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA), Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO) and Advertising Standards Authority (ASA) agreed to join up their efforts.

item.title: Investment trust votes, conflicts of interest, and our role

item.title: FCA fines Dinosaur Merchant Bank Limited for market abuse surveillance failures
item.description: The FCA has fined Dinosaur Merchant Bank Limited (DMBL) £338,000 for failing to put in place effective systems and controls to detect and report suspicious trading in its contracts for difference (CFD) business.

item.title: My FCA marks first year with a single, streamlined sign in for all firms
item.description: As part of ongoing improvements to My FCA, and following the successful removal of RegData sign in at the end of last year, we have now removed direct access to Connect and the Online Invoicing System.

item.title: FCA responds to Complaint Commissioner’s report on the British Steel Pension Scheme
item.description: We sympathise with former members of the British Steel Pension Scheme (BSPS) who lost money after they were given unsuitable advice from people they trusted.

item.title: Equity for Growth (Securities) Limited enters liquidation
item.description: On 25 March 2026, following a petition filed by the FCA, the High Court ordered that Equity for Growth (Securities) Limited (EFG) be wound up.

item.title: FCA sets out next phase of smarter, more effective regulation
item.description: We have set out plans for using AI to speed up authorisations, testing new tools to identify key risks earlier, with our people remaining at the heart of decision-making.
